unbalancedTransactions.description: Zoek transacties waarbij de som van de regels NIET gelijk is aan 0

get.description:
The search term is matched against the ledger code, name, category, and RGS code.
The type filter accepts `debit` or `credit`; the category filter accepts `balance` or `profit_loss`.
Results are sorted by ledger code.
get.summary: List active ledger accounts, optionally filtered by a search term and ledger type

post.summary: Register a new transaction, its journal entries and an optional invoice

invoice.description: An optional invoice with its items.

contact_id.description: The invoice contact: either an existing contact (contact_id) or a new contact to create (contact).

items.description: The optional invoice items (required as soon as an invoice is passed).

attachments.description: Optional invoice attachments, sent as one or more base64 encoded files.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
